subject.title: [Bug]: All channels enter broken state after 2026.6.11 update — one message per session then permanent silence

question: Should this be treated as another v2026.6.11 reply-session initialization conflict fixed by v2026.7.1-beta.2, or tracked as a distinct cross-channel duplicate/silence bug?
rationale: The symptoms strongly overlap a closed package-parity issue, but this report lacks the exact log signature and adds recovery details that could point to a separate persistent session or channel queue state problem.

options.title: Ask for beta/current-main retest
options.body: Keep this open and request affected logs plus a retest on v2026.7.1-beta.2 or newer before deciding whether it is fixed or distinct.

options.title: Close as beta-fixed after confirmation
options.body: If the reporter or maintainer logs show the reply-session initialization conflict and the beta package resolves it, close this as fixed by the beta/current-main package work.

options.title: Track as distinct regression
options.body: If the issue reproduces on the fixed package or lacks the conflict signature, keep it as a separate gateway/session/channel queue investigation.

recommendation.title: Ask for beta/current-main retest
recommendation.body: Keep this open and request affected logs plus a retest on v2026.7.1-beta.2 or newer before deciding whether it is fixed or distinct.

likelyOwner.reason: They verified the related package fix and are the best routing candidate for deciding whether stable-package proof is sufficient here.
